attributes.title: 2027 TCORN Symposium: Perioperative Advocacy in Action
attributes.venue: Hilton Garden Inn Austin Convention Center
attributes.organizer: Texas Collaboration of periOperative Registered Nurses
attributes.summary:
OR nurses earn 5 contact hours on a Saturday, January 30, 2027, at the Hilton Garden Inn Austin Convention Center, or attend virtually. The credit comes through Terri Goodman & Associates, a California Board of Registered Nursing provider (CEP 16550), so nurses in other states should check that their board accepts it.

Nonmembers may find it cheaper to pay $25 to join and use the member rate. The member early price ends November 25, 2026.
